questions.question: Find the value of sqrt{8}+2sqrt{32}-sqrt{128}+2sqrt{50} .
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Convert all into same root form

√8 = 2√2, √32 = 4√2, √128 = 8√2, √50 = 5√2

Expression = 2√2 + 2×4√2 − 8√2 + 2×5√2

= (2 + 8 − 8 + 10)√2 = 12√2

**∴ Answer = 12√2**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

√8 + 2√32 − √128 + 2√50

**Concept Used:**

Simplification of surds

**Calculation:**

⇒ √8 = √(4×2) = 2√2

⇒ √32 = √(16×2) = 4√2

⇒ √128 = √(64×2) = 8√2

⇒ √50 = √(25×2) = 5√2

⇒ Substitute values

⇒ = 2√2 + 2(4√2) − 8√2 + 2(5√2)

⇒ = 2√2 + 8√2 − 8√2 + 10√2

⇒ = (2 + 8 − 8 + 10)√2

⇒ = 12√2

**∴ The correct answer is 12√2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

√(a×b) = √a × √b

questions.question: If 20 percent of a number is added to 60, the result is that number. 70 percent of that number is ................
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

0.2x + 60 = x

0.8x = 60 ⇒ x = 75

70% of x = 0.7 × 75

= 52.5

**∴ Answer = 52.5**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

20% of a number when added to 60 gives the number

**Formula used:**

Percentage = (value ÷ 100) × number

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let the number be x

⇒ 20% of x = (20/100) × x = 0.2x

⇒ According to question

⇒ 0.2x + 60 = x

⇒ x − 0.2x = 60

⇒ 0.8x = 60

⇒ x = 60 ÷ 0.8 = 75

⇒ Required percentage = 70% of 75

⇒ = (70/100) × 75

⇒ = 52.5

**∴ The correct answer is 52.5.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

questions.question: A local cinema sells tickets for ₹150 per ticket for youth and ₹250 per ticket for adults. One evening, the theater sold a total of 200 tickets and earned ₹38,000. Find the number of youth tickets and adult tickets sold?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Assume all 200 are youth ⇒ 200 × 150 = 30000

Extra needed = 38000 − 30000 = 8000

Each adult adds extra 100

Adults = 8000 ÷ 100 = 80 ⇒ Youth = 120

**∴ Answer = Youth = 120, Adults = 80**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Total tickets = 200

Price of youth ticket = 150

Price of adult ticket = 250

Total earning = 38000

**Formula used:**

Linear equations

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let youth tickets = x and adult tickets = y

⇒ x + y = 200 ...(1)

⇒ 150x + 250y = 38000 ...(2)

⇒ Divide (2) by 50

⇒ 3x + 5y = 760 ...(3)

⇒ From (1): x = 200 − y

⇒ Substitute in (3)

⇒ 3(200 − y) + 5y = 760

⇒ 600 − 3y + 5y = 760

⇒ 600 + 2y = 760

⇒ 2y = 160

⇒ y = 80

⇒ x = 200 − 80 = 120

**∴ The correct answer is Youth = 120, Adults = 80.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Assumption Method

Assume all items of one type, then adjust using difference

Linear Equations

Form equations using total and value

Difference Concept

Extra value per unit helps find quantity quickly

questions.question: What will come in place of X in the equation (X)/(75) = (12)/(X) , when it is X > 0 ?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Directly cross-multiply the terms of the given equation.

X × X = 75 × 12

X² = 900

Since X > 0, taking the positive square root gives X = 30.

**∴ The correct answer is 30.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

X / 75 = 12 / X

Condition: X > 0

**Calculations:**

⇒ X / 75 = 12 / X

⇒ X × X = 12 × 75

⇒ X² = 900

⇒ X = √900

⇒ X = ±30

Since it is given that X > 0, we can ignore the negative value.

⇒ X = 30

**∴ The correct answer is 30.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Cross-Multiplication Rule

If two fractions are equal in the form a / b = c / d, then by cross-multiplying, we get a × d = b × c.

Quadratic Roots and Constraints

For any equation x² = a, the roots are x = √a and x = −√a. Always verify the constraints provided in the question (like x > 0) to select the valid root.

questions.question: If x − y = 3 and xy = 18 , then what will be the value of x² − y²?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

ऐसे दो मान ज्ञात कीजिए जिनका अंतर 3 और गुणनफल 18 हो।

स्पष्ट रूप से, x = 6 और y = 3 दोनों शर्तों को पूरा करते हैं (6 − 3 = 3 और 6 × 3 = 18)।

x² − y² = 6² − 3² = 36 − 9 = 27

**∴ The correct answer is 27.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**दिया गया है:**

x − y = 3

xy = 18

**प्रयुक्त सूत्र:**

(x + y)² = (x − y)² + 4xy

x² − y² = (x − y)(x + y)

**गणना:**

⇒ (x + y)² = 3² + 4 × 18

⇒ (x + y)² = 9 + 72

⇒ (x + y)² = 81

⇒ x + y = √81 = 9

⇒ x² − y² = (x − y)(x + y)

⇒ x² − y² = 3 × 9

⇒ x² − y² = 27

**∴ The correct answer is 27.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

महत्वपूर्ण बीजगणितीय सर्वसमिकाएँ (Important Algebraic Identities)

(a + b)² = a² + b² + 2ab

वर्गों का अंतर (Difference of Squares)

a² − b² = (a − b)(a + b)

योग, अंतर और गुणनफल के बीच संबंध

(a + b)² − (a − b)² = 4ab

questions.question: Find the simple interest (in ₹) on ₹2,000 at 7% per annum for the period from 4 February 2023 to 18 April 2023.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Feb (4–28) = 25 days, March = 31 days, April (1–18) = 18 days

Total days = 25 + 31 + 18 = 74

SI = (2000 × 7 × 74) ÷ (100 × 365)

= 28.38

**∴ Answer = 28**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Principal = 2000

Rate = 7% per annum

Time = 4 Feb to 18 April 2023

**Formula used:**

SI = (P × R × T) ÷ 100

**Calculation:**

⇒ Days in Feb (4 to 28) = 25 days

⇒ Days in March = 31 days

⇒ Days in April (1 to 18) = 18 days

⇒ Total days = 25 + 31 + 18 = 74 days

⇒ Time in years = 74 ÷ 365

⇒ SI = (2000 × 7 × 74) ÷ (100 × 365)

⇒ = 1036000 ÷ 36500

⇒ ≈ 28.38

**∴ The correct answer is 28.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

questions.question: What is the arithmetic mean of the observations 42, 29, 42, 58, 18, 39, 41, 79 and 93?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Sum = 42 + 29 + 42 + 58 + 18 + 39 + 41 + 79 + 93 = 441

Total numbers = 9

Mean = 441 ÷ 9 = 49

**∴ Answer = 49**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Observations = 42, 29, 42, 58, 18, 39, 41, 79, 93

**Formula used:**

Mean = (Sum of observations) ÷ (Number of observations)

**Calculation:**

⇒ Sum = 42 + 29 + 42 + 58 + 18 + 39 + 41 + 79 + 93

⇒ = 441

⇒ Number of observations = 9

⇒ Mean = 441 ÷ 9

⇒ = 49

**∴ The correct answer is 49.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

questions.question: The sum of two numbers is 60 and their HCF and LCM are 12 and 72 respectively. Then find the sum of the reciprocals of the two numbers.
questions.solution:

Product = HCF × LCM = 12 × 72 = 864

Sum = 60

1/a + 1/b = (a + b)/ab = 60/864

= 5/72

**∴ Answer = 5/72**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Sum of two numbers = 60

HCF = 12, LCM = 72

**Formula used:**

Product of two numbers = HCF × LCM

1/a + 1/b = (a + b)/ab

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let numbers be a and b

⇒ ab = 12 × 72 = 864

⇒ a + b = 60

⇒ Required = 1/a + 1/b

⇒ = (a + b)/ab

⇒ = 60/864

⇒ = 5/72

**∴ The correct answer is 5/72.**

questions.question: In △ABC, at point D, BD ⟂ AC and ∠DBC = 33°. E is a point on BC such that ∠CAE = 70°. What is the measure of ∠AEB?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

In right triangle BDC, angle C = 90° − angle DBC

Angle C = 90° − 33° = 57°

Apply Exterior Angle Theorem in triangle AEC

Angle AEB = angle CAE + angle C

**∴ Answer = 70° + 57° = 127°**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

In triangle ABC, BD ⟂ AC ⇒ angle BDC = 90°

Angle DBC = 33° and angle CAE = 70°

Point E lies on BC

**Formula used:**

Sum of angles in a triangle = 180°

Exterior angle = sum of opposite interior angles

 
 
• 
•

 70° 
 ? A D C B E 

 

Calculation:

⇒ In right triangle BDC:

⇒ angle BDC + angle DBC + angle BCD = 180°

⇒ 90° + 33° + angle BCD = 180°

⇒ angle BCD = 180° − 123° = 57°

⇒ Since A, D, C are collinear ⇒ angle ACE = angle BCD = 57°

⇒ Now in triangle AEC:

⇒ angle CAE = 70°

⇒ Using exterior angle property:

⇒ angle AEB = angle CAE + angle ACE

⇒ angle AEB = 70° + 57°

⇒ angle AEB = 127°

∴ The correct answer is 127°.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Exterior Angle Theorem

The exterior angle of a triangle equals the sum of its two opposite interior angles. Formula: Exterior angle = sum of opposite interior angles

Angle Sum Property

Right Triangle Property

questions.question: After a discount of 54% on the marked price of an item, it is sold for ₹ 29,946. Find its marked price (in ₹).
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

After 54% discount ⇒ Selling Price = 46% of Marked Price

So, MP = SP ÷ 0.46

MP = 29946 ÷ 0.46

MP = 29946 × (100 ÷ 46)

**∴ Answer = 65100**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Discount = 54%

Selling Price (SP) = 29946

**Formula used:**

SP = MP × (100 − Discount)% ÷ 100

**Calculation:**

⇒ SP = MP × 46 ÷ 100

⇒ 29946 = MP × 46 ÷ 100

⇒ MP = (29946 × 100) ÷ 46

⇒ MP = 2994600 ÷ 46

⇒ MP = 65100

**∴ The correct answer is 65100.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Marked Price (MP)

The listed price of an item before any discount is applied.

Discount Formula

Discount = MP − SP

Selling Price Relation

SP = MP × (100 − Discount%) ÷ 100

Quick Percentage Trick

If x% discount is given, remaining value = (100 − x)% of MP

questions.question: A teacher's current age is four times the age of one of her students. Five years ago, the teacher's age was seven times the age of the same student at that time. What is the teacher's current age (in years)?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let student age = x ⇒ teacher = 4x

5 years ago: (4x − 5) = 7(x − 5)

Solve quickly: 4x − 5 = 7x − 35

3x = 30 ⇒ x = 10 ⇒ teacher = 4x = 40

**∴ Answer = 40 years**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Present age of teacher = 4 × student

5 years ago, teacher's age = 7 × student's age

**Formula used:**

Linear equations based on age relations

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let present age of student = x

⇒ Present age of teacher = 4x

⇒ 5 years ago:

⇒ Teacher's age = 4x − 5

⇒ Student's age = x − 5

⇒ According to condition:

⇒ 4x − 5 = 7(x − 5)

⇒ 4x − 5 = 7x − 35

⇒ 30 = 3x

⇒ x = 10

⇒ Teacher's present age = 4 × 10 = 40

**∴ The correct answer is 40 years.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Age Problems Concept

Let present ages be variables and adjust according to past or future conditions.

Linear Equation

Equations of form ax + b = cx + d are solved by grouping like terms.

Past Age Formula

n years ago age = present age − n

Ratio Concept

If one age is k times another, represent as kx for easy solving.

questions.question: A total profit of ₹27,600 is to be distributed among A, B and C such that A : B = 18 : 6 and B : C = 7 : 12. What is C's share (in ₹) of the profit?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Make B common: A : B = 18 : 6 ⇒ divide by 6 ⇒ 3 : 1

B : C = 7 : 12 ⇒ make B = 7

So scale first ratio: 3 : 1 ⇒ 21 : 7

Final ratio A : B : C = 21 : 7 : 12

**∴ Answer = (12 ÷ 40) × 27600 = 8280**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Total profit = 27600

A : B = 18 : 6 and B : C = 7 : 12

**Formula used:**

Convert ratios to a common term and divide total in ratio

**Calculation:**

⇒ A : B = 18 : 6 = 3 : 1

⇒ B : C = 7 : 12

⇒ Make B equal in both ratios

⇒ LCM of 1 and 7 = 7

⇒ A : B = 3 : 1 ⇒ 21 : 7

⇒ B : C = 7 : 12

⇒ So A : B : C = 21 : 7 : 12

⇒ Total parts = 21 + 7 + 12 = 40

⇒ C’s share = (12 ÷ 40) × 27600

⇒ C’s share = 8280

**∴ The correct answer is 8280.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Ratio Conversion

To combine ratios, make the common term equal using LCM.

Profit Sharing

Share = (individual ratio ÷ total ratio) × total amount

LCM Method

Use LCM to equalize common terms in multiple ratios

Simplification Trick

Always reduce ratios before combining to make calculations easier

questions.question: A man has to travel a distance of 132 km in 14 hours. If he travels two-thirds of this distance in (3)/(7) of the total time, what should be his speed (in km/hr) to cover the remaining distance in the remaining time?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total distance = 132 km, total time = 14 hr

2/3 distance = 88 km done in (3/7 × 14) = 6 hr

Remaining distance = 44 km, remaining time = 8 hr

Required speed = 44 ÷ 8

**∴ Answer = 5.5 km/hr**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Total distance = 132 km

Total time = 14 hours

Distance covered = 2/3 in 3/7 of total time

**Formula used:**

Speed = Distance ÷ Time

**Calculation:**

⇒ Distance covered = (2/3) × 132 = 88 km

⇒ Time taken = (3/7) × 14 = 6 hours

⇒ Remaining distance = 132 − 88 = 44 km

⇒ Remaining time = 14 − 6 = 8 hours

⇒ Required speed = 44 ÷ 8

⇒ Required speed = 5.5 km/hr

**∴ The correct answer is 5.5 km/hr.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Speed Formula

Speed = Distance ÷ Time

Fraction Concept

Part of quantity = Fraction × Total value

Remaining Quantity

Remaining = Total − Completed

Time Distribution

Split total time proportionally using given fractions

questions.question: A cricketer's average score in 12 innings is 52 runs. In the 13th innings, he scores 183 runs. His average score increases by _____. (Round off the answer to the nearest whole number.)
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total runs in 12 innings = 12 × 52 = 624

Add 13th inning: 624 + 183 = 807

New average = 807 ÷ 13 ≈ 62.08

Increase = 62.08 − 52 ≈ 10.08

**∴ Answer = 10**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Average of 12 innings = 52

Runs in 13th inning = 183

**Formula used:**

Average = Total runs ÷ Number of innings

**Calculation:**

⇒ Total runs in 12 innings = 12 × 52 = 624

⇒ Total runs in 13 innings = 624 + 183 = 807

⇒ New average = 807 ÷ 13 ≈ 62.08

⇒ Increase in average = 62.08 − 52 = 10.08

⇒ Rounded value = 10

**∴ The correct answer is 10.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Average Formula

Average = Total sum ÷ Number of terms

Total from Average

Total = Average × Number of terms

Increment Concept

Increase = New average − Old average

Rounding Rule

If decimal ≥ 0.5, round up; otherwise round down

questions.question: Two trains are traveling in opposite directions at the same speed. If each train is 968 m long and they pass each other in 22 seconds, what is the speed of each train?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Opposite direction ⇒ relative speed = sum of speeds

Total distance = 968 + 968 = 1936 m

Relative speed = 1936 ÷ 22 = 88 m/s

Each train speed = 88 ÷ 2 = 44 m/s

**∴ Answer = 44 m/s**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Length of each train = 968 m

Time to cross each other = 22 sec

Trains move in opposite directions

**Formula used:**

Relative speed = Total distance ÷ Time

**Calculation:**

⇒ Total distance covered = 968 + 968 = 1936 m

⇒ Relative speed = 1936 ÷ 22 = 88 m/s

⇒ Let speed of each train = v

⇒ Opposite direction ⇒ relative speed = v + v = 2v

⇒ 2v = 88

⇒ v = 44 m/s

**∴ The correct answer is 44 m/s **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Relative Speed

Opposite direction ⇒ speeds add, Same direction ⇒ speeds subtract

Train Crossing Concept

Total distance = sum of lengths when two trains cross each other

Speed Conversion

m/s to km/hr ⇒ multiply by 18 ÷ 5

Basic Formula

Speed = Distance ÷ Time

questions.question: Which of the following numbers is divisible by 3?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Divisibility rule of 3: sum of digits must be divisible by 3

781 ⇒ 7+8+1 = 16 (not divisible by 3)

123 ⇒ 1+2+3 = 6 (divisible by 3)

245 ⇒ 2+4+5 = 11 (not divisible by 3), 557 ⇒ 17 (not divisible)

**∴ Answer = 123**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Options: 781, 123, 245, 557

**Formula used:**

A number is divisible by 3 if sum of its digits is divisible by 3

**Calculation:**

⇒ 781 ⇒ 7 + 8 + 1 = 16 (not divisible by 3)

⇒ 123 ⇒ 1 + 2 + 3 = 6 (divisible by 3)

⇒ 245 ⇒ 2 + 4 + 5 = 11 (not divisible by 3)

⇒ 557 ⇒ 5 + 5 + 7 = 17 (not divisible by 3)

**∴ The correct answer is Option 2 (123).**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Divisibility Rule of 3

If sum of digits is divisible by 3, the number is divisible by 3

Divisibility Rule of 9

If sum of digits is divisible by 9, the number is divisible by 9

Quick Check Trick

Add digits mentally to eliminate wrong options fast

Common Mistake

Do not check last digit; always check sum of digits for divisibility by 3

questions.question: A grocer marked his goods 80% above the cost price and sold them at a discount of X%. If he made a profit of 8%, find the value of X.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Assume CP = 100

MP = 100 + 80% = 180

Profit 8% ⇒ SP = 108

Discount = 180 − 108 = 72 ⇒ % = (72 ÷ 180) × 100

**∴ Answer = 40%**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Marked Price = 80% more than Cost Price

Profit = 8%

**Formula used:**

SP = CP × (1 + Profit%)

MP = CP × (1 + Markup%)

Discount% = [(MP − SP) ÷ MP] × 100

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let CP = 100

⇒ MP = 100 + 80% of 100 = 180

⇒ SP = 100 + 8% of 100 = 108

⇒ Discount = 180 − 108 = 72

⇒ Discount% = (72 ÷ 180) × 100

⇒ Discount% = 40%

**∴ The correct answer is 40%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Marked Price Concept

MP = CP × (1 + Markup%)

Profit Formula

SP = CP × (1 + Profit%)

Discount Formula

Discount% = [(MP − SP) ÷ MP] × 100

Shortcut Idea

Always assume CP = 100 to simplify percentage problems

questions.question: The price of fuel decreases by 30%, 25%, and 45% in three consecutive months, but increases by 45% in the fourth month. By what percent did the price of fuel increase/decrease in the fourth month compared to the original price? (Round the answer to two decimal places.)
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Successive change formula: Final = Initial × (1 − 30%) × (1 − 25%) × (1 − 45%) × (1 + 45%)

= 100 × 0.70 × 0.75 × 0.55 × 1.45

= 100 × 0.4186875 = 41.86875

Net change = 41.86875 − 100 = −58.13125%

**∴ Answer = 58.13% decrease**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Successive decreases: 30%, 25%, 45%

Then increase: 45%

**Formula used:**

Final value = Initial × (1 ± change%)

**Calculation:**

⇒ Assume initial price = 100

⇒ After 30% decrease ⇒ 100 × 0.70 = 70

⇒ After 25% decrease ⇒ 70 × 0.75 = 52.5

⇒ After 45% decrease ⇒ 52.5 × 0.55 = 28.875

⇒ After 45% increase ⇒ 28.875 × 1.45 = 41.86875

⇒ Net change = 41.86875 − 100 = −58.13125%

⇒ Rounded value = 58.13% decrease

**∴ The correct answer is 58.13% decrease.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Successive Percentage Change

Final value = Initial × (1 + a/100) × (1 + b/100)...

Decrease Formula

After x% decrease ⇒ multiply by (1 − x/100)

Increase Formula

After x% increase ⇒ multiply by (1 + x/100)

Important Note

Successive percentages are multiplicative, not additive
